items.title: Uniform fourth-degree bound for fields defining prime torsion of genus-three hyperelliptic Jacobians
items.author: Amalia Pizarro-Madariaga; Edgardo Riquelme
items.difficulty_reason: The counted object includes the full nonroutine genus-three Frobenius and extension-degree analysis, not merely its short final maximal-bound synthesis: symplectic compatibility exclusions, rational canonical blocks, nilpotent exponent cases and semisimple orders are carried through Types I–VIII with original tables and all exceptional-small-prime branches. Old209271 only counts the elementary orbit-layer lemma349–370; the complete uniform degree construction and genus-three restrictions are additional content. Original assumptions ell prime distinct from characteristic, odd base characteristic and the stated curve model retained without adding hypotheses. Sharpness example and speculative higher-genus remarks uncounted; no author computations rerun.
